source: inst
Strategy, 21.11.2026: inputs for today's saver talk with Dudu. Data window 21.10-20.11 (part ev.all) and Israel weeks w1025, w1101, w1108, w1115 (the last one is 15-20.11, six days). platform "web" = the site, "Android" = the app.
1. Car checks (car_lookup) app vs web, for the whole window and for each week (ev.all, ev.week).
2. Saves: car_save and car_unsave by platform and by "from" since 27.10 (sv.from27), and by week (sv.fromWeek). Which "from" values carry most saves.
3. File door: file_cta_shown vs mine_set by "from", per week; doc_add, doc_exp, svc_add counts (file.door).
4. Alerts and reminders: alerts_toggle, alert_kind, calendar_reminder_shown and calendar_reminder_click, notif_sent and notif_open, by platform and kind, per week (al.kind, al.where).
5. Share: share_open and share by platform and kind per week, and by tab where present (sh.kind, sh.tab).
6. iPhone web: home_sheet and home_open by act and by os (ios.act, ios.os, ios.week), and website visits by operating system per week (rum.os.*): the iOS share of web visits.
7. Compare and buy: compare_open, buy_card_open, recall events, bulk_check, fleet and business-report events by "from" (cmp.from). Car checks by fuel where present (lk.fuel).
8. Visits to /business/ pages per week (rum.biz.*).
9. Which parts failed and why, in words.
